mapper.select:
WITH t1 AS (
SELECT * FROM easydata.tb_easydata_user_trackinfo_complete_all WHERE statis_date IN
#{day}
AND trmnl_style IN
#{item}
AND wt_et IN
#{item}
AND wt_mc_ev IN
#{item}
AND wt_es IN
#{item}
),
t2 AS (
SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE CASE WHEN data_source = '51006' THEN toString(FROM_UNIXTIME(intDiv(toInt64OrZero(ifNull(wt_dcsdat,'0')),1000))) WHEN data_source IN ('51007','51010') THEN toString(FROM_UNIXTIME(intDiv(toInt64OrZero(ifNull(dcsdat,'0')),1000))) ELSE wt_dcsdat END BETWEEN #{statisticsTimeStart} AND #{statisticsTimeEnd} ),
t3 AS (
SELECT ${checkField}, count(*) AS statistics_num FROM t2 GROUP BY ${checkField} ORDER BY statistics_num DESC LIMIT 100 ),
t4 AS (
SELECT t3.*, toDecimal64(statistics_num * toDecimal64(100.0,6) / (SELECT SUM(statistics_num) FROM t3),2) AS statistics_occupy FROM t3 ),
t5 AS (
SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE CASE WHEN data_source = '51006' THEN toString(FROM_UNIXTIME(intDiv(toInt64OrZero(ifNull(wt_dcsdat,'0')),1000))) WHEN data_source IN ('51007','51010') THEN toString(FROM_UNIXTIME(intDiv(toInt64OrZero(ifNull(dcsdat,'0')),1000))) ELSE wt_dcsdat END BETWEEN #{compareTimeStart} AND #{compareTimeEnd} ),
t6 AS (
SELECT ${checkField}, count(*) AS compare_num FROM t5 GROUP BY ${checkField} ORDER BY compare_num DESC LIMIT 100 ),
t7 AS (
SELECT t6.*, toDecimal64(compare_num * toDecimal64(100.0,6) / (SELECT SUM(compare_num) FROM t6),2) AS compare_occupy FROM t6 )
SELECT
CASE WHEN COALESCE(t4.statistics_num,0) != 0 THEN t4.${field} WHEN COALESCE(t7.compare_num,0) != 0 THEN t7.${field} ELSE COALESCE(t4.${field}, t7.${field}) END AS ${field} ,
COALESCE(t4.statistics_num,0) AS statistics_num, COALESCE(t4.statistics_occupy,0) AS statistics_occupy, COALESCE(t7.compare_num,0) AS compare_num, COALESCE(t7.compare_occupy,0) AS compare_occupy,
(COALESCE(t4.statistics_num,0) - COALESCE(t7.compare_num,0)) AS absolute_change,
CASE WHEN toDecimal64(COALESCE(t7.compare_num,0),0) = 0 THEN CASE WHEN toDecimal64(COALESCE(t4.statistics_num,0),0) = 0 THEN toDecimal64(0.0,1) ELSE toDecimal64(100.0,1) END ELSE toDecimal64( (toDecimal64(COALESCE(t4.statistics_num,0),0) - toDecimal64(COALESCE(t7.compare_num,0),0)) * toDecimal64(100.0,6) / toDecimal64(COALESCE(t7.compare_num,0),0), 1 ) END AS change_rate
FROM t4 FULL OUTER JOIN t7 ON
ifNull(t4.${field}, '') = ifNull(t7.${field}, '')
